column3: NASB renders “sober-minded” as “temperate,” “self-controlled” as “sensible,” and “endurance” as “perseverance.”
NASB adds “are to be” and renders “slanderers” as “malicious gossips.”
NASB renders “train” as “encourage” and reorders the verse.
NASB follows the critical text (“workers at home”); “be denigrated” is rendered “be dishonored.”
NASB follows the critical text without “incorruptibility”; “works” is rendered “deeds,” and “unspoilable” is “purity.”
NASB follows the critical text (“us”); “he who is of the contrary” is rendered “the opponent,” and “be ashamed” is “be put to shame.”
NASB adds “Urge” and renders “servants” as “bondslaves” and “gainsaying” as “argumentative.”
NASB follows the critical text; “fidelity” is rendered “good faith.”
NASB renders “passions” as “desires,” “discreetly” as “sensibly,” and “piously” as “godly.”
NASB reads “Christ Jesus,” the order of other manuscripts; “awaiting” is rendered “looking for.”
NASB renders “all lawlessness” as “every lawless deed,” “specially chosen” as “for His own possession,” and “works” as “deeds.”
